output.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount_eur FROM marts.fct_orders o WHERE o.is_revenue = true AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01';
output.explanation: Total discount on completed orders in 2025 is the sum of discount_amount in fct_orders, filtered to is_revenue = true (status = 'completed') and order_date within calendar year 2025 (fiscal year equals calendar year). The result is rounded to 2 decimals in EUR.
